name: calendula officinalis flowering top
uses: Uses For temporary relief of minor symptoms of vaginitis, such as itching, burning and irritation.
otcwarn: Do not use if you are allergic (hypersensitive) to any of the ingredients found in the insert after expiration date on carton Ask a doctor before use if you have strong vaginal discharge vaginal bleeding Ask a doctor or pharmacist before use if you are presently taking other vaginal insert drug products Stop use and ask a doctor if no improvement is seen after three to four days your symptoms worsen you experience irritation from using the product
